definitions.ask: Should the never-loaded Mac `com.bbugyi.bob-gcal-sync` LaunchAgent be retired?
definitions.why: Docs describe a 5-minute agent that never ran; loading it would now commit the note all day

choices.label: Delete the plist via chezmoi; docs say sync is on demand plus once at note creation
Keep the unloaded plist; docs warn loading it commits the note every 5 min
